chunk.content: Rastrelliger brachysoma (short mackerel), one of the Rastrelliger fishes sold as gembolo, reaches a maximum fork length of 34.5 cm and is commonly 15 to 20 cm.
chunk.source_quote: Maximum fork length is 34.5 cm, common from 15 to 20 cm

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2. Scombrids of the World (Collette & Nauen 1983), section incl. Rastrelliger
